name: komdosh-dev-infra-k8s
description: Kubernetes manifests, hardening, workload troubleshooting, and ArgoCD delivery. Three agents with disjoint verbs — author, auditor, diagnostician — split by what you are doing rather than which tool, so a Deployment and the Application that ships it stay one change. Author and auditor work on the rendered manifest, because an overlay can silently drop a hardening patch the base contains. The diagnostician separates sync status from health status and refuses workarounds that hide a symptom. Never mutates a cluster; rollback is git revert. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
